_about: Combat calculator data. rules = how a turn resolves; skills = what each tree node does in a fight (keyed by node id); weapons and foes = presets for the Combat page. Edit by hand; the app reloads. Fields starting with _ are ignored.

rules.note: Attacks roll a d20. A natural 20 is a critical hit: damage dice are doubled (glossary).
What an attack must reach: DefenceBase + the target's Agility skill. Not decided yet — tune here.
1 = a natural 1 always misses, 0 = no auto-miss.
Least damage a hit deals after Armour. 0 = Armour can stop a hit completely.
Rage gained when one of your attacks deals damage. Doc: taking damage builds more than dealing it.
Rage gained each time you take damage (Held Wounds damage counts).
Burst of Rage for a kill.
Rage lost on a turn in which you neither deal nor take damage (Barbarian Pathway).
First threshold: Blooded and other threshold nodes switch on.

Endurance check (d20 + Endurance) against this, once per turn, when Rage went past the cap that turn. Fail: lose control next turn and lose Sanity equal to the overflow. Once-per-turn is Claude's proposal; the doc says each gain past the cap.
Endurance check for Unbroken when Rage hits 0.
A fight still going after this many turns counts as a draw.

bbr.headlong1.name: Headlong
bbr.headlong1.text: Charge up to 10 m and strike; builds 1 Rage on impact, 2 if you are struck during the charge. You end the charge in the middle of them. Usable on the first turn of a fight.

bbr.headlong2.name: Headlong II
bbr.headlong2.text: The charge also deals 1d6 damage on impact.

bbr.unmake1.name: Unmake
bbr.unmake1.text: Spend all Rage on one strike: +1d6 damage per 2 Rage spent. Rage drops to 0.

bbr.blooded1.name: Blooded
bbr.blooded1.text: At 5 Rage or more, melee attacks deal +1d4 damage.

bbr.berserker1.name: Berserker
bbr.berserker1.text: Lower your guard until your next turn: Armour halved, every hit you take builds 1 extra Rage.

bbr.pastred1.name: Past the Red
bbr.pastred1.text: At 10 Rage, damage dice are doubled. No retreat and no non-Rage skills while it lasts.

bbr.redmist2.name: Red Mist
bbr.redmist2.text: Rage gained above 10 is banked as +1d6 on your next hit, up to 3d6. The surge check still rolls; a failed check loses control for a turn and 1 Sanity per banked point.

bbr.thickit1.name: Thick of It
bbr.thickit1.text: Gain 1 Rage each turn if two or more enemies are within reach.

bbr.bitedown1.name: Bite Down
bbr.bitedown1.text: Spend Rage to recover 1d6 HP per 2 Rage spent. Spending to 0 releases Held Wounds.

bbr.grudge1.name: Grudge
bbr.grudge1.text: The first time each enemy hits you, gain 1 extra Rage.

bbr.dti1.name: Draw Them In
bbr.dti1.text: Spend 2 Rage on an Intimidation shout: enemies in reach make a Composure check or must attack you next turn. (Solo fights: every foe already attacks you, so this only logs who failed.)

bbr.hw1.name: Held Wounds
bbr.hw1.text: While Rage is above 0, hold back up to CON modifier × 2 damage of each hit. When Rage hits 0, everything held lands at once.

bbr.corpse.name: Corpse-Eater
bbr.corpse.text: Consume a fallen enemy: restore 1d6 HP and gain 2 Rage. Leaves you open (foes attack with advantage until your next turn) and adds 1 fel per corpse.

bbr.ironmind.name: Iron Mind
bbr.ironmind.text: When a spell targets you, spend 1 Rage to gain advantage on the check against it. (Foes cast no spells yet.)

bbr.unbroken.name: Unbroken
bbr.unbroken.text: When Rage hits 0, make an Endurance check. On a success, held damage lands a third per turn over 3 turns instead of at once.

weapons.name: Greataxe
weapons.note: Placeholder: weapon AP comes from gear once gear exists.

foes.name: Bandit
foes.note: Placeholder numbers until a bestiary exists.

foes.name: Training dummy
foes.note: Never hits back. Use it to measure damage per turn.
